description: KFLT v1 frozen vector for memberKey(pubkeyHex, saltHex) (PROTOCOL.md §1), for @forgesworn/tessera-kit. keyedCases: memberValueHex = sha256(bytes(saltHex) || bytes(pubkeyHex)), saltHex non-empty. openCase: memberKey(pubkeyHex) with salt omitted MUST equal pubkeyHex verbatim. rejectCases: memberKey MUST throw for each (follow-up audit fix: an EMPTY salt makes sha256('' || pk), computable by anyone holding the bare pubkey, so it is rejected outright, not accepted as a distinct-but-weaker keyed value). Independently hand-checked via node:crypto at generation time.

rejectCases.description: empty salt (memberKey(pk, '') gives no protection — anyone can compute sha256('' || pk))
rejectCases.expectedErrorSubstring: salt must be non-empty even-length hex
